allowed_candidate_classes.rule: One algebraic functional F must act on generation-invariant pre-existing sector feature bundles across all charged sectors; no particle-name branch is allowed.
One generation-varying relative-release operator D must be applied by the same algebraic rule to charged-lepton, down-quark and up-quark families; no up-only residual repair is allowed.

reclassification_rule: Any class-A proposal using mode, generation, generation-varying v7 or another within-sector varying field is reclassified as class B before testing.
required_structural_inputs: v7 orientation coordinate where class B applies
White-Thread open-holonomy coordinates where structurally applicable
forbidden: residual-derived factor or approximation to the known 24.18 offset
candidate scan selected by the known charged-fermion mass table
known charged-fermion table described as a prospective holdout
silent promotion of heavy-sector rows marked old_doc_bridge_ansatz_quarantined
removal of the mandatory Ramanujan layer
more than three retained candidate formulas
using a generation-varying coordinate while labelling the candidate a sector-invariant baseline

cross_transfer_gate.rule: Every candidate must emit structural coordinates for all charged-fermion sectors, including at least one sector not used to motivate the candidate. A singleton light-up correction is not admissible.

class_A_sector_invariant_baseline.name: direct charm-to-tau Higgs coupling ratio
class_A_sector_invariant_baseline.dataset_rule: Use the first public joint ATLAS/CMS likelihood or combination released after 2026-07-28 that reports direct charm and tau Higgs-coupling information without converting the current charged-fermion mass table into the target.
class_A_sector_invariant_baseline.success_rule: The frozen prediction must lie inside the published 95% confidence region; otherwise record FAIL.

class_B_universal_generation_release.name: direct charm-to-top Higgs coupling ratio
class_B_universal_generation_release.dataset_rule: Use the first public joint ATLAS/CMS likelihood or combination released after 2026-07-28 that reports direct charm and top Higgs-coupling information without converting the current quark-mass table into the target.
class_B_universal_generation_release.success_rule: The frozen prediction must lie inside the published 95% confidence region; otherwise record FAIL.

fallback_if_primary_dataset_unavailable.rule: Retain the candidate as structural only; do not replace the named observable after inspecting alternatives.
